question: Points \(A\) and \(A'\) are centrally symmetric about point \(O\). If \(OA=3.5\), find the length of \(AA'\).
solution: Under central symmetry, the center of symmetry is the midpoint of the segment joining corresponding points, so \(AA'=2OA=7\).
